searchText: taking a look today! maybe we should clarify this <@755590043632140352> can you ask your claude if it's happy with the changes (it requires changes to prysm impl) I don't feel strongly. Seems redundant but easy to add. yeah just kept it out for now, we don't have it in v1 Oh God! I knew it was a mistake to be involved with the API people. I dislike Enrico's Claude that adds an explicit pending node to the output, but I dislike more delaying stuff, so close my PR and merge whatever you guys want on this and I'll modify Prysm to adapt to it For the record, even this PR for an endpoint that absolutely no one uses ever, ever, ever, not even the pandaOps guys and forky use this endpoint, has like 10 comments in it. I wish my Prysm PRs would get this attention i can see that we could filter the pending node.. it was just a natural full FC dump for us. but then we need to add a `pending_weight` to nodes to have those votes. but i'm not convinced at all. I'd rather stick to current
